notes.title: Added FOV setting
notes.content:
Some players asked for this setting, so here is it!
[list]
[*] FOV setting
[/list]

notes.title: Improved screen filter
notes.content: Improved the screen filter to add dithering. Making it fit better with the style of my other games.

notes.title: Shader fix on Steam Deck
notes.content:
A small but important fix affecting Steam Deck:
[list]
[*] Removing division by zero to fix wall shader
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of life improvements
notes.content:
A couple small but important updates!

[list]
[*] The game loads the window configuration before starting, preventing weird window jumps
[*] The game starts loading when the window is created, preventing further weird behavior
[*] Added "Ignore controllers" setting (must restart the game to take effect), to allow playing with Mouse and Keyboard without controllers interfering
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixing update!
notes.content:
Small update to fix a couple of bugs ahead of Steam Next Fest:
[list]
[*] Red tint remaining after game restart
[*] Missing vacuum cleaner shadow
[/list]

notes.title: Improving render quality
notes.content:
I've improved the settings for Anti Aliasing and scaling.

To ensure everyone can play without issues I've also added a Quality setting with 3 quality levels:
[list]
[*] Low
[*] Medium
[*] High
[*] Ultra
[/list]

I've also changed the first mandatory Anomaly from None to Red Eyes. To help players understand the loop of the game (without an anomaly the 18th floor was confusing).

notes.title: Adding Stats savefile
notes.content:
Adding a separate savefile for stats (seconds played). This allows to:
[list]
[*] Reset the game without affecting stats
[*] Sync stats with Steam Cloud
[*] Save stats to disk frecuently
[/list]

This change will reset the count on the amount of time played. If you want to get the 2 hour achievement you can left the game open (unpaused!) so the time advances.

Remember that you can check the amount of time played in the ingame clock!

notes.title: Minimizing freezes when loading new floor
notes.content:
Made the following changes to minimize freezes when loading a new floor:
[list]
[*] Loading only one robot per frame
[*] Slowing down player while loading
[*] Blocking player for reaching the end of the stairs, if robots are still loading
[/list]

In normal conditions players should never reach the block at the end of the stairs, they should only feel a slight deceleration.
But if for some reason robots are still loading the player will be stopped at the end of the stair so they can't see the robots loading.

notes.title: Infinite undergroud bug fixed
notes.content: Fixed a bug that made the underground floors go down to infinite, without any anomaly.

notes.title: Late game fixes
notes.content:
Made changes to address some issues on the late part of the game:

[list]
[*] Now the museum scenario correctly rotates to properly face the player stair
[*] Made some fixes to the allocation of anomalies to prevent missing anomalies
[*] Fix to game ending prematurely
[*] Fix to underground floor count
[/list]

notes.title: Dificulty adjusted
notes.content:
After receiving feedback that going back to floor 18 punish the player too much I desided to make the following change:
[list]
[*] Now the player goes back 1 floor
[*] I may change it to 2 floors, if 1 makes the game too easy
[/list]

Please comment if you have another idea on how this should be handled. Thanks!
